Hornbills nest walled up in tree holes
scenes.body: The male seals the female in with mud, leaving a small opening to pass food through.

scenes.headline: Every species does it, except the two ground hornbills

scenes.headline: Remix this with a hornbill from your region

caption:
The original showed one hornbill. Here's the rule it follows.

Britannica counts about 60 hornbill species. Remix photo: Indian grey hornbill; split clips: southern yellow-billed hornbill (Kalahari) and Abyssinian ground hornbill (zoo).

Source: Britannica.  Photos/video: Wikimedia Commons (credits on screen).
notes: Remix demo: side-by-side layout mirrors Instagram's native Remix (low risk); our half adds an Indian species and the rule-plus-exception. CC clip stands in for the original reel.
